The '''Kor Vella Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The cantina was situated next to a deep chasm running through the city. It was an elongated building with two entrances. Two [[Wind turbine/Legends|wind power generators]] atop the building provided energy for the business.

The interior featured a long bar, where a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] sold beverages. Along the walls were several booths with tables and chairs where people could sit down and drink. A door behind the counter led to a small back room where [[Music/Legends|music]] instruments, loudspeakers and other equipment for [[Band/Legends|live acts]] were stored. Another room in the back of the cantina wasn't in use and empty as of 1 ABY.

Among the regular customers of this cantina were the criminals [[Lasha Bindari]], who worked for [[Shalera]] the Hutt, and [[Skinkner]], who worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate.

==Behind the scenes==
The cantina in Kor Vella is one of the typical [[:w:c:swg:Cantina|cantinas]] in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The developers used the building model that was also used for most other cantinas in the game.

Like all cantinas in the game, it features a bartender that sells a small selection of drinks as well as various [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPCs) of random gender, appearance and professon. There are also two NPCs that give out short quests: [[Lasha Bindari]] and [[Skinkner]].
